description: BKK Radar's monthly rent index for condos: median rent, rent per m², listings and change on the month before, for Bangkok, one district or one line. Started in October 2026; the current month is provisional. Returns the index page.

district.description: District (khet) of Bangkok, e.g. "Watthana", "Khlong Toei", "Sathon". Without district or line: the whole city.
